venues.weather: Sunny w/ late afternoon rainshower, H85 L69
venues.narrative: **CC ATL — Monday 8/3.** MOD MKZ. Net $1,150 vs target $727 (+58.2%); food $229; comps $47.52 (community/investor, industry love, bingo credit, O4W, tip-only discount); 36 guests / $31.95 check avg. Smooth Monday, similar to last week. Day 1 of bartender training for Jayden Chin — digital platforms, Core Values, Brand Pillars, Service & Hospitality docs. 12 Meal Deals all day; lull around 8pm, then usual service-industry pop 9–11pm. Bar lined at end of night — service-industry night gaining traction. BOH ticket times great; truck order placed slightly late due to training (MKZ picks up at Will Call tomorrow). Liquor order arrives tomorrow. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Monday 8/3.** AM MOD Carey, PM MOD Maggie H. Net $6,417.69 vs target $6,810 (-5.8%); DC/AM $915.72, D&C PM $5,684.07, Garden/6A closed; food $1,484.40; comps $299.90; 140 guests (Tock). Rain kept the day very slow — didn't break $3k until 7–8pm; sales walked in after the Rockies game. Two large parties plus two late-night 9-tops kept opener and host on later than planned. Kitchen: great night with Rachel, Danté, Marv; heavy 911 prep list (tarts, chicken thighs, scallop crudo, basil vin, pasta dough, mixed mushrooms); 86'd tarts, chicken thighs, scallop crudo, pasta; low chicken breast, mignonette. Events: Avalon Bay Inc. meeting tomorrow 8am–5pm in suite 6A (10 guests) — coffee/hot water/creamers ready at 8am; use Garden door for 6A access. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Monday 8/3.** MOD Kyler/Thomas, Chef Kyler. Net $4,724 vs target $3,990 (+18.4%); food $538, beverage $4,186; comps $99.45 (Koba birthday, member); 117 guests / $41 check avg. Quiet open, then sustained build to a packed house by 8pm — fended off a waitlist despite a heavy reservation book; 7-top at 8pm, 6-top at 10pm, quiet after midnight. Team described as 'a ridiculously tight machine' — Dante on cocktails, Kyler cheffing and running, Haleigh timing seatings perfectly. 117 covers, 10 solos, 2 large parties, 70 oysters, 1 investor cocktail; 7 birthdays including Koba's. Top sellers: Rosalie, High Plains Drifter. Maintenance: hook ripped off top bathroom; tap reader acting up — a paid-out ticket reappeared after showing full transaction and signature (flagged as concerning). One no-show (party of 3), not charged.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Monday 8/3.** MOD Mikey, Chef Vic. Net $3,304 vs target $4,400 (-24.9%); Marquee $3,304 (food $794), Standing Room $0; comps $170.40 (DNL, misring, Julian & wife, birthdays, anniversary, Sam from Hojokban, employee discounts); 84 guests / $82.61 check avg. Sleepy Monday that never really picked up. Familiar faces through the night — Julian & his lady, Sam from Hojokban — plus a good number of happy first-timers. Last-minute party of 4 at last call stayed for one nightcap round. Easy, fast close; no cash sales; no 86s or lows from bar or kitchen. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Rainstorms on and off all day
venues.narrative: **MG — Monday 8/3.** AM Sam & Shannon, PM Justin & Marcus. Net $2,702 vs target $4,000 (-32.5%); Municipal Bar AM $844 / PM $1,858; Sun Club $0; Hot Eye $0; food $1,217; comps $233; guests 30 AM + 75 PM (OpenTable). Rainstorms on and off all day. Quiet morning with the usual noon pop — one server sufficed; Aimee completed first training shift at prep. Evening ran on 2 servers + SA, no host; good walk-in action ~6pm as people ducked out of a downpour; James had an almost-full bar around 8:30. Sun Club: zero guests all day due to rain; closed early ~4:30; WO placed for upstairs kegerator. Kitchen: steady given the weather; 86'd affogato (prepped tomorrow); wasted a quarter bag of expired oysters. New staff ticket competition started — Eva and Sierra leading. No incidents.
